description.value: Arbutus Coffee is a neighbourhood coffeehouse in Kitsilano occupying a Class A Heritage Building at the corner of 6th and Arbutus Street that has served the community in some form since 1907. Operating in its current café incarnation since 2002, it is known for expertly-pulled espresso, house-made baked treats, and a warm, easygoing atmosphere cultivated by a long-standing local team. Touring cyclists passing through Kitsilano will find freshly-ground coffee and a solid selection of sandwiches, quiche, and baked goods made in-house.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms Arbutus Coffee is an active café with a detailed menu of beverages and house-made food, supporting confirmed_open. The contact page provides a phone number (604) 736-5644 and a street address of '2200 Arbutus Street, Vancouver, BC V6J 3Y1' that conflicts with the OSM address of '2200 West 6th Avenue'; the About Us page corroborates the corner location at 6th and Arbutus Street, so the website address is preferred. The menu explicitly lists vegan (Overnight Oats), vegetarian (Vegetarian Quiche), and gluten-friendly (Powerbar) items; no evidence exists on the website for bike infrastructure, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi.
